title: Super Staffs
description: This mod adds a magic system with custom crafting and ten staff tiers. Each staff grants unique abilities such as lightning fire ice teleportation destruction and invisibility. Progression is controlled through a custom crafting machine using twelve recipe
body:
# Magic Staffs Mod

*It's a pretty nice Mod With Magical Staff that is progression based from tier 1 to tier 10, with a custom block entity that is used to crafting and upgrading them! i like it hehe*
## Guide https://youtu.be/vmC130oQVX0
---

# Progress


**I made ABOUT 12 Custom Recipes for my Custom Block Entity.**

**Here's the full Guide of items, crafting system, and staff powers.**

---

# main Crafting Items that are needed

**Magic Gem**

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e63-7d17-7484-ab19-d652da1f7ed9/image.png)

*This is basically the first ever item you will need , you need it to craft ALMOST EVERYTHING.*

---

**Arcane Runes (Magic Station)**


![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e63-d1de-7f07-acd6-278ad8dda780/image.png)

*This is the Custom Block Entity I spent Hours making , You mainly use it to craft the staff tiers and upgrade them , its the 2nd thing you gotta craft after the magic gem thing*

---

# Staff Progression

**Tier 1 Staff (Basic)**


![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e64-52c7-70dc-b43c-f76a276ee100/image.png)
![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e6b-c233-7885-a105-a1542d3393e3/image.png)

* It's so basic just gives postive effects aka  buffs that already exist in Minecraft  when right-clicked.*

---

**Tier 2 Staff**

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e64-c5b3-7988-960d-66687a025919/image.png)

*It's just a Tier 1 staff but with improved Levels same effects but its Level 3 effects instead of Level 1 or lvl 2.*

---

**Tier 3 Staff (Lightning Staff)**

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e67-2434-7a30-8952-a7c6b0551f9d/image.png)

*Summons lightning whereever  the player right clicks, IT DOES TONS OF  damage.*

---

**Tier 4 Staff (Fireball Staff)**

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e67-b3fe-7def-a6dc-632f9c23d5b2/image.png)

* Have you ever wanted a fireball that you always tired in Bedwars ? , HERE IS IT!!!! , be careful it hurts alot.*

---

**Tier 5 Staff (Ice Staff)**

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6c89-5b4a-7a17-9cbc-764a6b9a8903/image.png)

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e6a-8339-7d2c-aebf-54fef963334d/image.png)

* It throws an ice frozen attack that does also tons of dmg and turns most surrounding blocks and explode some of it into ICE.*

---

**Tier 6 Staff (Water Staff)**

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e6b-9b1b-7cae-9d41-aa7c3dec4bf0/image.png)

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6c8c-2ac7-7cd9-a021-6a59f8377a14/image.png)

* You can change the terrain and turn stuff into water *

---

**Tier 7 Staff (Lava Staff)**

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e6b-ac2e-72ab-ba05-86aae0ecd025/image.png)

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6c8c-a387-754f-9d7e-1446b7701653/image.png)

*It's like the water staff but its lava this time. ITS PRETTY DANGEROUS*

---

**Tier 8 Staff (Blinker / Teleport Staff)**

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e6b-c233-7885-a105-a1542d3393e3/image.png)

*It lets you insta teleport or Fly but spamming Blink or right click , like an enderman or a ender pearl with no fall damage or damage at all*

---

**Tier 9 Staff (DESTROYER Staff)**

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e6c-36ef-785e-a037-3ac68c62cbd2/image.png)

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6cae-b47f-7564-b89d-5278e08ec807/image.png)

* It's so god damn dangerous , its basically a CHUNK DESTORYER  it destorys and corrupts your  world.*

---

**Tier 10 Staff (Ghost / Invisibility Staff)**

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6e6d-384a-7361-8340-8e5498125197/image.png)

![image](https://cdn.hackclub.com/019e6caf-026d-7f0b-b97a-2fe0035f31d8/image.png)

*Makes the player invisible to escape detection of mobs and players .*

---

**That's all for now.**

**I REALLY enjoyed making this mod and learning how to create full magic systems in Minecraft.**

**The journey was worth it.**
